title: Creamy Sweet Potato Bowl
description: A comforting and nutritious bowl filled with roasted sweet potatoes, creamy sauce, and various toppings.
instructions: Toss the sweet potatoes with olive oil, salt, and black pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the sweet potatoes are tender.
While the sweet potatoes are roasting, prepare the creamy sauce by blending together 1 cup of cashew cream, 1/2 cup of nutritional yeast, and 1 tablespoon of lemon juice.
Once the sweet potatoes are done, transfer them to a bowl and drizzle with the creamy sauce.
Top with chopped fresh herbs and serve immediately.
Serve in a large bowl and enjoy!
